The Composer

About

K3lvin Kaos is a music producer and composer with more than 1,000 verified television, film and sports placements.

Through K3lvin Kaos Music, he creates cinematic, high-energy and emotionally driven music for visual media. His current focus brings that experience into games, trailers and interactive storytelling.

Every project begins with the developer's world, story and creative direction.

Custom Game Music Interactive Audio Original Score Composition

Let's Meet DuringPLAY.NYC

I'll be attending PLAY.NYC @ Anime NYC throughout the event. If you're an indie developer looking for custom music, interactive audio or someone to help define your game's sonic identity, I'd love to connect.
